spec_match.rationale: Six candidate RouterSource values are offered to a real addRoutes call inside a real install event, one at a time, and the browser's own rejection messages are printed verbatim.

interactive.rationale: A button installs a fresh worker version and re-probes, which is necessary because an install handler runs once per version and a returning visitor would otherwise see no report.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The page claims only what it measures: which sources this browser accepts, and that rejections arrive asynchronously.

edge_cases.rationale: A worker with no fetch handler cannot use fetch-event or the race source; an invented source fails at enum conversion; a returning visitor gets no fresh install report and is told why.

references.rationale: chromestatus.com/feature/5194817700364288 and the addRoutes specification section.

conformance.rationale: Three concept-level assertions: addRoutes exists on InstallEvent.prototype (checked from a plain worker), URLPattern discriminates sibling paths, and navigator.serviceWorker.controller is observable. The feature-level suite predates this concept and was left untouched.

runtime_evidence.rationale: deno task drive in Chrome 150: four of six sources accepted, both invented sources rejected by name, all four real routes installed, and the synchronous call measured as not throwing for any source.

telemetry_health.rationale: Emits accepted counts, installed route count and whether addRoutes exists.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables, button colour pairs, 44px controls, table in its own scroll container.

accessibility.rationale: Semantic table with row headers, aria-live summary, verdicts as text rather than colour alone.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Single-column layout with the wide table scrolling in its own container.

guidanceConsulted.query: announce results of an asynchronous probe in a live region
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce outcomes in a live region and disable the control that starts them while they run.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The re-install button disables for the duration; the summary is written into an aria-live output on completion.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: deno task drive waits on the rendered rows before asserting.

summary: Added as a new concept to the canonical folder for this feature id rather than as a new folder — the duplication gate caught an attempt to create v154/optional-browser-optimization-for-service-workers for a feature already built at v131 and v140.
